title: 在美国网购退货，英语怎么说？
summary: 美国网购退货很方便，大多免费。这篇教你申请退货、要退货标签、去网点寄回的说法。

phrases.en: Can you email me the return label?
phrases.zh: 能把退货标签发到我邮箱吗？

phrases.en: When will I get my refund?

dialogue.speaker: Customer
dialogue.en: Hi, I'd like to return these shoes. They're the wrong size.
dialogue.zh: 你好，我想退这双鞋。尺码不对。

dialogue.speaker: Store Clerk
dialogue.en: No problem. Do you have the receipt?

dialogue.speaker: Customer
dialogue.en: Yes, here. I bought them online. I need a return label.
dialogue.zh: 有，在这。网上买的。我需要一张退货标签。

dialogue.speaker: Store Clerk
dialogue.en: I'll print one for you. Just stick it on the box and drop it off.
dialogue.zh: 我给你打印一张。贴在箱子上拿来就行。

dialogue.speaker: Customer
dialogue.en: Great. When will I get my refund?
dialogue.zh: 太好了。退款什么时候到？
